claim: Adobe posted $1.7B in net income for the fiscal second quarter of 2026.
summary: Adobe fiscal Q2 2026 would be reported around June 2026, after the knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04 and before today's date of 2026-10-28. Without browsing tools or prior knowledge covering this future reporting period, the $1.7B net income figure cannot be verified or refuted.

sub_claims.note: Adobe fiscal Q2 2026 ends May/June 2026 and is reported mid-June 2026, after the 2026-01-04 knowledge cutoff. No prior knowledge establishes this value and no tools are available to verify.

sub_claims.text: The reporting period was the fiscal second quarter of 2026
sub_claims.stated_text: for the fiscal second quarter of 2026
